prop.v: collect_geometries(array_foreach(generate_series(1, coalesce(num_geometries(simplify(if(geometry_type($geometry) = 'Polygon', boundary(force_polygon_ccw($geometry)), $geometry), 0.5)), 1)), with_variable('r', coalesce(geometry_n(simplify(if(geometry_type($geometry) = 'Polygon', boundary(force_polygon_ccw($geometry)), $geometry), 0.5), @element), simplify(if(geometry_type($geometry) = 'Polygon', boundary(force_polygon_ccw($geometry)), $geometry), 0.5)), with_variable('cd', array_filter(array_foreach(generate_series(2, num_points(@r) - 1), if(cos(azimuth(point_n(@r, @element - 1), point_n(@r, @element)) - azimuth(point_n(@r, @element), point_n(@r, @element + 1))) < 0.574, distance_to_vertex(@r, @element - 1), NULL)), @element IS NOT NULL), if(array_length(@cd) = 0, @r, collect_geometries(array_cat(array_foreach(generate_series(1, array_length(@cd) - 1), line_substring(@r, @cd[@element - 1], @cd[@element])), if(is_closed(@r) AND NOT (cos(azimuth(point_n(@r, num_points(@r) - 1), point_n(@r, 1)) - azimuth(point_n(@r, 1), point_n(@r, 2))) < 0.574), array(line_merge(collect_geometries(array(line_substring(@r, array_last(@cd), length(@r)), line_substring(@r, 0, array_first(@cd)))))), array(line_substring(@r, array_last(@cd), length(@r)), line_substring(@r, 0, array_first(@cd)))))))))))

with_variable('i', 2.0, collect_geometries(array_filter(array_foreach(generate_series(1, coalesce(num_geometries($geometry), 1)), with_variable('g', coalesce(geometry_n($geometry, @element), $geometry), with_variable('n', floor((length(@g) - 2 * 1.0) / @i), if(length(@g) < 2.0, NULL, collect_geometries(array_foreach(generate_series(0, if(@n < 1, 0, @n - 1)), line_substring(@g, if(@n < 1, length(@g) / 2, (length(@g) - @n * @i) / 2 + @i / 2 + @element * @i) - 0.1, if(@n < 1, length(@g) / 2, (length(@g) - @n * @i) / 2 + @i / 2 + @element * @i) + 0.1))))))), @element IS NOT NULL)))
